description: CORRECTED root cause (2026-09-24, run 01M39RPNK): the sandbox qualitygate graph red was NOT an in-image fabro parser. The seeds toolchain image ships NO fabro at all (.fabro/Dockerfile.toolchain deliberately does not port it) but HAS graphviz. scripts/qualitygate.nu graph-parse arm PREFERS dot -Tcanon when dot is on PATH, falls back to fabro validate on hosts without dot. Plain graphviz rejects unquoted x.-prefixed attribute keys (petri grammar from seeds commit 4728193) as invalid DOT ID syntax -> 'syntax error in line 7 near .'. On a host without dot but with fabro 0.362 (e.g. the dev laptop) the same gate validates GREEN via the fabro arm - hence local GATE GREEN vs sandbox GATE RED.
resolution: Fix belongs to the loop-asset line (seed candidates): quote the x.* keys in workflow.fabro files (needs server-packager quote reconciliation - known irreconcilable-in-one-file tension), or make the gate petri-aware (prefer fabro validate / skip dot arm), or bake a petri-capable fabro into the image.
